2026-10-09ISEDBoards of Trade ActOrder Approving the changes of the boundaries of the district of The Town of Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce, in OntarioOrder approving the application by the Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce, in Ontario, to change the boundaries of the district of the Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce from the Town of Strathroy, Township of Caradoc, Township of Adelaide, Township of Metcalfe and former geographic Township of Lobo to Middlesex County, excluding the City of London and the area in Thames Centre south of highway #2.N/A
subject: Order Approving the changes of the boundaries of the district of The Town of Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce, in Ontario
precis: Order approving the application by the Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce, in Ontario, to change the boundaries of the district of the Strathroy and District Chamber of Commerce from the Town of Strathroy, Township of Caradoc, Township of Adelaide, Township of Metcalfe and former geographic Township of Lobo to Middlesex County, excluding the City of London and the area in Thames Centre south of highway #2.
